name: ue57_artclaw_highlight
description: Highlight, select, and focus actors in UE Editor viewport. Find actors by name, keyword, class type, or tag, then select and pilot camera to them. Use when AI needs to: (1) locate specific actors in the scene, (2) highlight/select multiple actors by filter, (3) focus viewport on a target actor. UE only (Maya/Max have no equivalent highlight API). Replaces old MCP tool: highlight_actors.
